headline: Board Meeting Outcome for Board Meeting Outcome For Unaudited Financial Results (Consolidated And Standalone) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026 And Issuance Non-Convertible Debentures.
body:
In continuation of our letter dated October 27, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today, has, inter alia:
approved the Unaudited Financial Results (Consolidated and Standalone) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026; and
passed an enabling resolution authorising the issuance of listed, secured / unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures up to Rs. 15,000 crore, in one or more tranches, on private placement basis.
exchangeCategory: Board Meeting / Outcome of Board Meeting

headline: Listing Of Equity Shares Of Jio Platforms Limited
body:
Trading in equity shares of Jio Platforms Limited (JPL) will commence from October 28, 2026. 

Further, a meeting of board of directors of JPL is scheduled to be held on Friday, October 30, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of JPL for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
body:
The meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on October 30, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve:
a. the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026; and 
b. raising of funds by way of issuance of listed, secured / unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures on private placement basis, in one or more tranches. 

The Company will hold an analyst meet, post the Board Meeting, to discuss the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering And Approving The Standalone And Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026 And Raising Of Funds By Way Of Issuance Of Debentures
body:
Reliance Industries Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 30/10/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve a. the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026; and
b. raising of funds by way of issuance of listed, secured / unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures on private placement basis, in one or more tranches.

headline: Initial Public Offer Of Jio Platforms Limited - Update
body: JPL has today finalised the Issue Price at Rs. 1,119 per Equity Share and has also filed Prospectus dated October 24, 2026 with the Registrar of Companies, Gujarat at Ahmedabad.
